### workspace tile --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace tile [options] [project]

Tile all active windows for a project across the screen.
Auto-detects the project from the current directory if not specified.
Matches the base project and all its worktree sessions.
Exits 1 when every matching project is headless: it has no window to tile.

Options:
        --all                        Tile all active workspace projects

Examples:
  workspace tile    # tile the current directory's project and its worktrees side by side
  workspace tile window-tool    # tile window-tool and all its window-tool.* worktree windows
  workspace tile --all    # tile every active workspace window across the screen
--- stderr
--- end
